from itertools import permutations
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from collections import defaultdict

x = list(range(5))
rho_counts = defaultdict(int)
for perm in permutations(x):
    rho = round(spearmanr(x, list(perm))[0], 4)
    rho_counts[abs(rho)] += 1

total = 120
print('Exact p-values for n=5 Spearman:')
print(f'|rho|     count_ge  two-tailed  one-tailed')
for rho_abs in sorted(rho_counts.keys(), reverse=True):
    count_ge = sum(c for r, c in rho_counts.items() if r >= rho_abs)
    print(f'{rho_abs:.4f}    {count_ge:3d}       {count_ge/total:.4f}      {count_ge/total/2:.4f}')
print()
print('Verify scipy asymptotic for rho=-0.9, n=5:')
# Create ranks that give rho=-0.9
import numpy as np
print(spearmanr([0,1,2,3,4], [4,3,2,0,1]))
"
